title: Blood Transcript Biomarkers Selected by Machine Learning Algorithm Classify Neurodegenerative Diseases including Alzheimer's Disease
summary: Across eight cohorts, results support exploratory disease/control discrimination, with variable performance by disease and cohort. Cross-cohort preprocessing and heterogeneous results limit interpretation; the panels are not established clinical diagnostics.
ai_technology: Random-forest feature selection and linear discriminant analysis evaluate blood-transcript panels across six neurodegenerative diseases.
organization: ASU-Banner Neurodegenerative Disease Research Center, Arizona State University, Tempe, Arizona, USA
